description:
Per JMAP-2koi decision (B): every extension *-server crate gets an AGENTS.md cookie-cut from the canonical `crate-jmap-mail-server/AGENTS.md` (109 lines).

Currently only 1 of 8 extension-server crates has an AGENTS.md. The other 7 are missing the canonical-template banner that the workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' rule presumes exists on every sibling.

## Sites (7 files to create)

  - crate-jmap-chat-server/AGENTS.md
  - crate-jmap-calendars-server/AGENTS.md
  - crate-jmap-tasks-server/AGENTS.md
  - crate-jmap-contacts-server/AGENTS.md
  - crate-jmap-filenode-server/AGENTS.md
  - crate-jmap-sharing-server/AGENTS.md
  - crate-jmap-metadata-server/AGENTS.md

## Cookie-cut shape (mirror mail-server)

Each sibling AGENTS.md must include:

  1. Title line (`# Agent Instructions — jmap-<thing>-server`)
  2. Canonical-template banner pointing AT mail-server as the canonical (sibling form: 'This crate is a sibling of the canonical jmap-mail-server. Mirror its shape; deviations must be motivated by spec differences only.')
  3. 'Before Starting Any Work' checklist with the relevant RFC / draft swapped in
  4. 'What This Is' (one-paragraph crate summary)
  5. 'Crate Family Context' diagram fragment
  6. 'Spec Reference' with the appropriate normative document path
  7. The 'Permission enforcement: backend canonical' section that JMAP-ga0q.2 wanted on chat-server (now applies workspace-wide; foundation seam is documented in workspace AGENTS.md)

Where mail-server's content is genuinely mail-specific (RFC 8621 sections, MailBackend trait names), substitute the sibling's equivalents. Where the content is workspace-wide policy, copy verbatim.

## Acceptance

  - 7 new AGENTS.md files exist, each ~80-150 lines.
  - Each file's canonical-template banner correctly identifies mail-server as the canonical.
  - Each file's 'Permission enforcement: backend canonical' section matches the workspace AGENTS.md identity-seam wording.
  - cargo test --workspace clean (sanity — doc additions cannot break tests but no extra cost to verify).
  - Spot-check by Mark on the chat-server one (highest-velocity sibling) before the others land.

## Out of scope

  - Updating mail-server's AGENTS.md itself (it is already canonical; sweeps update siblings).
  - Adding AGENTS.md to non-server crates (types-only, client-only crates have their own canonical-template story).
  - Reshaping the workspace AGENTS.md (JMAP-ga0q.2 already landed that).

## Cross-references

  - JMAP-2koi — the human decision that authorized this sweep
  - JMAP-ga0q.2 — the work that surfaced the missing-AGENTS.md gap (closed, but its chat-server site is functionally completed by this sweep)
  - workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' table — the policy this sweep implements
title: Sweep: cookie-cut AGENTS.md into 7 extension-server siblings (chat/calendars/tasks/contacts/filenode/sharing/metadata)
